name: quantum-metric
description: Analyze funnels, errors, friction and session replays in Quantum Metric to find and fix digital experience issues

interface.longDescription: Analyze funnels, errors, friction and session replays in Quantum Metric to find and fix digital experience issues across web and mobile apps.
defaultPrompt: Where are customers dropping out of checkout this week?
What are the top errors affecting conversion right now?
Review this session and tell me what went wrong.

positive.description: Top errors for the last day, ranked by affected sessions.
positive.prompt: What were the top errors yesterday?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most frequent errors from yesterday with occurrence counts, most frequent first, and names the top one.

positive.description: Find one session that hit the top error and explain what happened in it.
positive.prompt: Give me one session with the top error, then summarise what happened in that session.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one session that hit the top error, a short timeline of what the visitor did and where the error occurred, and a link to watch the session replay.

positive.description: List the dashboards the signed-in user can see.
positive.prompt: List the dashboards in this subscription.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the dashboards in the subscription by name. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: A plain count of recent traffic.
positive.prompt: How many sessions did we have today?
positive.expected_behavior: States the number of sessions so far today, with the workspace and time zone used.

positive.description: A follow-up that breaks the previous answer down.
positive.prompt: Break that down by device type.
positive.expected_behavior: Splits the same session count by desktop, mobile and tablet, and the parts add up to the total.

negative.description: A destructive request the plugin has no tool for. It must decline and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete all dashboards for this subscription.

negative.description: A bulk export of personal data. The plugin has no export tool and must not try to assemble one.
negative.prompt: Export every user's session data to a CSV.

negative.description: An unrelated request. The plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.
